form_title: 2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the General Election
reports.notes: Handwritten; fax scan (header 'Oct.26. 2010 10:18PM Ut Co Public Works'). Zeros are written as the dash-zero-dash glyph '-0-' and transcribed verbatim. Lines 3, 5 and 7 are written as NEGATIVE amounts ('$ -3,661' with a raised '05') - the minus sign is clearly present and is transcribed; it is the filer's own figure and no arithmetic was performed to check or correct it. Medium confidence on those three only because the handwritten thousands digit sits against the dollar sign. NOTE for a downstream reader: this filer's PRIOR report (key 9442c520, 6/14/10) closed at '-0-', so the beginning balance here does not carry that forward - the discrepancy is the filer's, recorded as printed, not reconciled. Cents are raised superscripts throughout. office_index 'County Surveyor' agrees with the page. candidate_index was blank; the page names GARY RATCLIFFE.

itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-19 wave B2 utah, chunk r2_02b)

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, written as the dash-zero-dash glyph '-0-' (read 0 under the repo ZERO-GLYPH RULING), matched by Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received', each a handwritten closed-loop zero
contributions.detail: Schedule A (p3) carries NO entries: the printed grid is empty on all 17 ruled lines except a two-line handwritten banner across the Name and Address columns of the first two lines — 'NO NEW CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED / SINCE REPORT FILED ON 6/14/10'. That is an annotation, not an entry (no date cell, no amount cell, nothing in the Amount column on any line), so the side is empty-schedule with ZERO rows, and zero rows sum to 0.00 — exactly the cover's promoted per-period cell and the schedule's own two printed zeros (900 dpi crop of pct:78,83.5,20,9@p3 rendered 'Subtotal for this page $ 0' and 'Total Contributions Received ... $ 0', both plain closed loops, neither a bare dash nor an empty cell). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 2,700.00 and is NOT summed as an increment. THE p2 BALANCE LADDER CLOSES ON ITS OWN TERMS AND IS NEGATIVE: line 3 -3,661.05 + line 4 (-0-) = line 5 -3,661.05; line 5 - line 6 (-0-) = line 7 -3,661.05. The negative sign is real and is kept (Addendum A4's Poulson precedent).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE, written '-0-' (read 0), matched by Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Expenditures MADE', each a handwritten closed-loop zero
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p4) likewise carries NO entries — 17 empty ruled lines under a two-line handwritten banner, 'NO NEW EXPENDITURES MADE / SINCE REPORT FILED ON 6/14/10'. Zero rows sum to 0.00 = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = its printed total (900 dpi crop of pct:78,83.5,20,9@p4 rendered both as plain closed-loop zeros). Column B YTD expenditures print 6,361.05 and are never summed as an increment; that figure is this filer's June report's own period total carried forward, which is consistent.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither schedule carries any entry, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the identical sum (0.00) on both sides and both close on the '-0-' Column A cells. Neither schedule prints an in-kind column and the cover prints no in-kind line.
itemized.escalation_note: Two escalations, both for legibility of the nil marks. make_snippet --dpi 900 on pct:78,83.5,20,9@p3 and pct:78,83.5,20,9@p4 rendered, on each page, the printed 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total ... $' labels each followed by a hand-drawn CLOSED LOOP — an unslashed handwritten zero. Under the repo ZERO-GLYPH RULING a written zero transcribes as 0 while a bare dash, 'N/A' or an empty cell stays blank; these are loops, so they are zeros and the sides are a real absence of entries. (The cover's own zeros are written in this filer's other convention, the dash-flanked '-0-', on lines 1, 2, 4 and 6 — same ruling, same reading.)

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'GARY RATCLIFFE' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face governs and is offered to the coordinator for promotion into that EMPTY channel cell. Office Seeking 'COUNTY SURVEYOR'; party 'REPUBLICAN'; residence city Springville, Utah (the street line is printed unredacted on the cover and is deliberately not carried). legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages, each classified from its OWN printed header: p1 COVER, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. Report type 'Seven days preceding the General Election', marked X; amendment answered 'No' with an X (an explicit answer, unlike this same filer's June filing, which left the amendment question wholly blank). Signed 10/26/10; the clerk's 'For Office Use Only' date-received box is EMPTY on this filing. Foliation 'Page 2 of 4', '3 of 4', '4 of 4' — the cover counted as page 1, the same convention this filer used in June. THE DOCUMENT IS A FAX and its header runs 'Oct.26. 2010 10:18PM Ut Co Public Works 801-851-8612' with fax-side page numbers 'P. 2' through 'P. 5', so as in this filer's June filing a fax cover sheet was transmitted and not retained; the report itself is complete at 4 of 4. On Schedule B the filer again struck 'Received' out of the printed 'Total Expenditures Received' and wrote 'MADE' beneath it. ~ BOTH SIDES ARE `empty-schedule`, NOT `no-schedule-page` AND NOT `withheld`: both schedule pages are present, printed and retained, all 17 ruled lines on each are blank, and each carries a two-line handwritten banner in the Name/Address columns — 'NO NEW CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED / SINCE REPORT FILED ON 6/14/10' on Schedule A and 'NO NEW EXPENDITURES MADE / SINCE REPORT FILED ON 6/14/10' on Schedule B. A banner is an annotation, never an entry. ~ A FILER INCONSISTENCY ACROSS HIS OWN CYCLE, RECORDED AND DELIBERATELY NOT ADJUDICATED (the Graves-seat precedent): this October cover's Column B year-to-date CONTRIBUTIONS print 2,700.00, which is the figure the same filer STRUCK THROUGH and corrected to 6,361.05 on his June cover (key 9442c520) — i.e. by October he has reverted to counting only the four outside contributions and is carrying his own 3,661.05 as a negative balance instead (line 3 / line 5 / line 7 all -3,661.05, and 2,700.00 - 6,361.05 = -3,661.05 exactly). Both treatments are transcribed as printed; neither is corrected, and no figure was differenced across the two covers to produce anything in this record. This is also the direct explanation of the wave's cover-chain flag that 'another report in the cycle reaches only 2,700.00' — it is this report's Column B, not a contradiction of the June schedules, which sum to 6,361.05 on their own page.
